name: cratylism
wording: held as the pattern's founding principle, never the fallacy of trusting a coined label to carry meaning: a name is natural to the model, its meaning already fixed by the universe of discourse, so each concept takes its Cratylic name; a kept name short of it is recorded as such
reason: The principle the project is named for, names natural rather than conventional, belongs to the pattern every context conforms to; read cold, a model can take it for the fallacy of trusting a label to carry meaning, which the correction excludes.
